about: Each tracker's super PACs in each House and Senate election, 2018 on: spending for and against House and Senate candidates (primaries and generals), the part that went to candidates who won in November, and how many of the candidates they backed won. Its own super PACs (kind own), or, for the lobbies that run none, its share of the super PACs its companies, PACs and trade groups gave to (kind funded). From the FEC's independent-expenditure, receipts and committee files and its official results (until those are out, the site's race calls). Written by npm run superpacs:midterms (scripts/build-midterm-trackers.mjs).
